DATA INTEGRITY · This is a replay of an explicitly hypothetical, two-dimensional numerical propulsion model—not evidence of a real antigravity drive. The untouched RC42 archive is the source of all state samples and issued commands; between-sample positions are interpolated. The confirmed GAD-off orbital observation is extended with a clearly labeled approximate two-body Neptune-relative orbit propagated from the last recorded insertion state; the independent GAD-off audit is summarized separately.
SIMULATION RC42 · K ≤ 300
Frozen benchmark: 32/32 tested routes verified

About this mission replay

This standalone file embeds 28,628 actual recorded trajectory states, 2,992 issued GAD command segments, and 30 recorded navigation assessments from the frozen RC42 Saturn → Neptune evidence package.

Use Play to watch the chapter-edited mission, click any chapter or timeline event to jump, and select a camera view. You can drag the starfield to pan, scroll to zoom, and use the arrow keys to scrub.

Engineering shows flight-profile plots and deeper values. The archived trajectory ends at orbital insertion. The V2 orbit view uses numerical propagation from the final recorded insertion state; it is not an additional archived flight sample stream. The derived orbit approximates, but does not exactly reproduce, the independently certified GAD-off audit.

Coordinates: 2D heliocentric X/Y plane. Units: positions and distance in kilometers; velocities in km/s. Time: elapsed from the configured departure epoch after a simulated 720-day launch wait. This is not a real calendar launch.

Archive verification: full independent command-history replay and GAD-off orbital verification passed for this case. The 32/32 campaign validates 32 tested cases, not all possible routes or future hardware.

All data are embedded. No network connection, account, external fonts, trackers, or web APIs are required.
